categories.main_business_segments: Gambol Pet Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of multi-category pet foods for dogs and cats. Its main products include scientifically formulated staple foods, snacks made from poultry and fish, and health supplements. The company operates both domestic and international markets, including OEM/ODM production for global clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as extrusion, freeze-drying, baking, and vacuum drying. It integrates international standards and proprietary innovations like fresh meat instant high-temperature emulsification and low-temperature vacuum fresh meat concentration. Digital tools and MES intelligent flexible production lines support customized formulations and efficient production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include end consumers purchasing through e-commerce platforms and offline pet specialty stores, pet hospitals, and distributors. Internationally, the company serves major retailers like Walmart and P&G, exporting to North America, Europe, Japan, and South Korea. The domestic market is the largest revenue source, with growing penetration in high-end pet food segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with nationwide coverage across 31 provinces through online and offline channels. It has overseas production bases and subsidiaries in Thailand, the United States, New Zealand, and Hong Kong, serving global markets including North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gambol Pet Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pet food supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and brand sales. It also manages upstream supply chain activities through global procurement of raw materials and owns production facilities domestically and abroad, ensuring control over quality and cost.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in product development, nutrition science, and manufacturing processes. It invests heavily in R&D centers across multiple locations, focusing on pet physiological research, functional ingredients, and customized nutrition. Digital transformation and supply chain digitization are strategic priorities to enhance operational efficiency and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of self-owned brands and OEM/ODM services. Sales channels include direct online sales via e-commerce platforms, online and offline distribution networks, and international wholesale to major retailers. The company also earns investment income from financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gambol Pet Group is a leading domestic pet food brand in China, holding the top market share among local brands and competing with international giants like Mars and Nestlé Purina. The company differentiates itself through innovation, quality certifications, and a strong multi-brand portfolio targeting various market segments including high-end pet foods.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 5.24 billion, a 21.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 624.7 million, up 45.68%. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and asset base, supported by expanding domestic and international sales and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gambol Pet Group emphasizes high-quality, scientifically formulated pet foods that respect the natural dietary needs of dogs and cats. Its products feature premium ingredients, innovative processing technologies, and comprehensive quality control with multiple international certifications. The company’s brands are positioned as natural, professional, and innovative, catering to health-conscious pet owners seeking premium nutrition.
